WITH ball_extra AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, SUM(extra_runs) as total_extra
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id
),
ball_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.bowler, b.innings_no,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(be.total_extra, 0) as ball_total
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN ball_extra be ON b.match_id = be.match_id AND b.over_id = be.over_id AND b.ball_id = be.ball_id

over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, bowler, innings_no, SUM(ball_total) as over_runs
    FROM ball_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, bowler, innings_no
)
SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, bowler, over_runs
FROM over_runs
WHERE match_id = 501252 AND over_id = 3 AND innings_no = 2
ORDER BY over_runs DESC
